name: shoulder-pip
title: Shoulder printed in place
description: The bench shoulder's compound planetary printed as one piece on a 17HS4401: housing and held ring, sun, three stepped planets and the output ring, every gap the printer's print gap, herringbone teeth so nothing walks off, no carrier. Free it with a turn by hand, then set the motor face down on the four posts on the roof and drive an M3x8 hex-head screw up through each, turned from outside with a 5.5 mm spanner in the post's window. 44.3:1 where the assembled shoulder is 38:1.
orientation: As drawn: the output ring, the planets' lower steps, the sun's hub and the housing's skirt on the bed, the motor's face up. Everything above another part rises at 45°: no supports.
